verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented way to converse with the assistant from WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or iMessage. The webhooks page covers outbound notifications to Discord or Slack and inbound posting of messages into Open WebUI channels, which is adjacent plumbing, not a two-way messenger chat surface. The PWA and OpenAI-compatible API are host-surface or developer building blocks, not a messenger integration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can talk to my assistant from the messengers I already use — WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or iMessage — not just a bespoke web page
